name: Rootd
one_liner: Rootd is a panic attack app with a one-tap panic button that talks you through breathing and grounding, plus short lessons on how panic works.
best_for: People who get panic attacks and want a guided tool to use in the moment
Learning what happens in the body during panic so it feels less frightening
Tracking when panic attacks happen and what sets them off
not_for: Anyone in crisis or thinking about suicide: call or text 988
First-ever chest pain or panic-like symptoms that have not been checked by a doctor
People who need treatment for panic disorder; therapy (CBT) is the standard treatment and this app does not replace it
short_description: Panic attack app with a one-tap panic button, guided breathing and grounding, and short lessons on understanding panic.
long_description: Rootd is a self-help app for panic attacks and anxiety, made by Simply Rooted Media in Canada. Its main feature is a large panic button (the 'Rootr') that walks you through slow breathing and grounding during an attack. It also has an introductory set of lessons on what panic is, a panic journal, an emergency contact button and audio exercises. The panic button and the 'Understanding' lessons are free; the longer lesson series and other content need a paid Full Access plan (monthly, yearly or lifetime). The company cites a six-week University of Victoria study, but we could not find it published in a peer-reviewed journal. It is a support tool, not treatment for panic disorder.
patient_summary: You open Rootd during a panic attack and tap one large button; it then guides your breathing and grounding step by step. Between attacks you can read short lessons and log your attacks. The panic button and the first lessons are free; the rest needs a paid Full Access plan.

pricing.starting_price: Free; Full Access about $79.99/year or $199 lifetime
pricing.notes: Free: panic button, 'Understanding' lessons and emergency contact. Full Access (monthly, yearly or one-time lifetime) unlocks the other lessons and features. Yearly and lifetime prices are as reported by a third-party review of Rootd's site in September 2026; a monthly offer of $9.99 was shown as limited-time. Prices vary by country and store; check the payment screen.

privacy.notes: Says it does not sell personal data, but may share data with third parties such as Facebook for advertising (with consent), and uses advertising and analytics vendors; deletion by emailing team@rootd.io; data processed in Canada.

seo.title: Rootd: Panic Attack Relief App | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Rootd helps during panic attacks with breathing exercises and grounding tools. Free version available. iOS & Android.

faqs.q: Does Rootd actually help during a panic attack?
faqs.a: Many users report that Rootd's 'Rootr' feature helps them get through panic attacks faster. The app uses evidence-based techniques like slow breathing and grounding that are proven to reduce panic symptoms. It's not a cure, but a helpful tool in the moment.

Rootd offers a free version with core panic relief features including the Rootr button, basic breathing exercises, and some educational content. Premium subscription unlocks all lessons, unlimited journal entries, and advanced features.

faqs.q: Can Rootd replace therapy for panic disorder?
faqs.a: Rootd is a self-help tool, not a replacement for therapy. For panic disorder, CBT with a therapist is the gold-standard treatment. Rootd works well as a supplement to therapy or as a first step while you wait to access professional help.

faqs.q: What makes Rootd different from other anxiety apps?
faqs.a: Rootd is specifically designed for panic attacks, not general anxiety or meditation. The app was created by someone with lived experience of panic disorder, so it's focused on what you actually need during a panic attack rather than general wellness features.

primary_uses: Guided breathing and grounding during a panic attack
Quick access to an emergency contact
contraindications: Not a substitute for medical evaluation of new chest pain or breathing symptoms

availability.note: Free to download in the US on iOS and Android.
